lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance white spots are visible across the mid-flank, with spots increasing in diameter and spacing toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Darker vertical bands of lower pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, creating a defined grid-like arrangement of high-contrast nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high-intensity light on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, elongated, high-luminance white feature, likely a remora, is attached to the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a high density of small, uniform, high-luminance circular spots across its entire surface area.
